Simple purées

Potato purée

Burgonyapüré

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Pair it with meat, lentils, or a fully cooked egg so the plate supplies iron. Cooking water, breast milk, or formula keeps cow's milk out.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 300 g floury potatoes (peeled weight)
  • 80 ml cooking water, breast milk, or formula (or the same amount of pasteurised full-fat cow's milk, which is a milk allergen)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the potatoes and cut them into even chunks.
  2. Boil in water until a knife slides through, with no salt in the pot.
  3. Drain, and keep some of the cooking water.
  4. Mash with cooking water, breast milk, or formula until smooth.
  5. Use pasteurised full-fat cow's milk only if you accept the milk allergen.
  6. Do not add salt.

Adjusted

Potato is low in iron, so a bowl of it is a poor meal on its own. Cow's milk adds a milk allergen, and salt is often mashed in.

Mash with cooking water, breast milk, or formula, and use pasteurised full-fat cow's milk only if that allergen is already the plan. Do not add salt, and serve the purée with meat, lentils, or a fully cooked egg.
